name: list-workflow-states
description: Lists the workflow states Linear issues move through (Backlog, Todo, In Progress, Done and the like) for every team, or for one team: each state's id, name, type (backlog, unstarted, started, completed or canceled) and position, and its team's id and key. A state's id is the stateId linear__create-issue and linear__update-issue take, from the issue's own team.

teamId.description: Narrows the list to one team: a team's id from linear__list-teams.
